items.q: Is religion simply disappearing everywhere in the same way?
items.correct: No — secularisation is debated and varies between societies.
items.misconception: Yes, religion is vanishing evenly worldwide.
items.why: Religion persists and changes differently across societies and can serve social functions.

items.q: According to sociologists, can religion influence society?
items.correct: Yes — it can promote social cohesion or, some argue, social control.
items.misconception: No, religion has no effect on society.
items.random_wrong: Religion only matters to individuals, never society.
items.why: Functionalists see religion building consensus; Marxists see it justifying inequality.
